parties.respondent: Lakhi Alias Lakhwinder Singh & Anr. Etc.

summary: Challenge to High Court setting aside summons under Section 319 CrPC; appellant claims sufficient evidence for summoning accused based on FIR and eyewitness accounts; respondents argue improbability of allegations, inconsistencies in versions, and exculpatory CCTV evidence; reliance on Brijendra Singh and Jamin for test of 'stronger evidence than mere possibility' under Section 319; issues of political rivalry and SIT findings raised; standard of judicial scrutiny at summons stage emphasized.
legal_provisions_cited: Brijendra Singh v State of Rajasthan, (2017) 7 SCC 706
Jamin v State of Uttar Pradesh, 2025 SCC OnLine SC 506
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter taken up de novo; final disposal pending further reasoning.
